info.name: Smart Irrigation API
info.description: Express/MongoDB API on port 5000 and independent built-in Node.js/file API on port 4000. Run in order with Collection Runner; create requests save plot IDs to collection variables.

exec: pm.test('200 and JSON health response', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.response.to.be.json; pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('ok'); });
pm.test('200 JSON array', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.response.to.be.json; pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array'); });

pm.test('201 and created plot fields', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.response.to.be.json; const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p).to.have.property('_id'); pm.expect(p.plotName).to.eql('Postman Demo Plot'); pm.collectionVariables.set('plotId', p._id); });
pm.test('200 and matching plot', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.response.to.be.json; pm.expect(pm.response.json()._id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('plotId')); });
pm.test('200 and updated plot', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.response.to.be.json; pm.expect(pm.response.json().plotName).to.eql('Postman Demo Plot Updated'); });
pm.test('400 validation error', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.response.to.be.json; pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.have.property('error'); });
pm.test('400 invalid ID', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.have.property('error'); });
pm.test('404 missing record', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.have.property('error'); });
pm.test('200 weather JSON array', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.response.to.be.json; pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array'); });

pm.test('200 recommendations with required fields', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.response.to.be.json; const rows = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(rows).to.be.an('array'); if (rows.length) { pm.expect(rows[0]).to.have.property('status'); pm.expect(rows[0]).to.have.property('reason'); } });
pm.test('404 JSON route error', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.response.to.be.json; pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.have.property('error'); });
pm.test('200 deleted', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.response.to.be.json; });
pm.test('200 core health JSON', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.response.to.be.json; pm.expect(pm.response.json().service).to.eql('core-node'); });
pm.test('200 JSON array with query filter', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.response.to.be.json; pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array'); });

pm.test('201 and core plot ID saved', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.response.to.be.json; const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p).to.have.property('id'); pm.collectionVariables.set('corePlotId', p.id); });
pm.test('200 core plot', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.response.to.be.json; pm.expect(pm.response.json().id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('corePlotId')); });
pm.test('200 updated core plot', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().plotName).to.eql('Core Demo Updated'); });
pm.test('400 validation error', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.have.property('error'); });
pm.test('404 missing record', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.have.property('error'); });
pm.test('404 route error', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.have.property('error'); });
pm.test('200 deleted core plot', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
